name: ultraterm-computer-use
description: Local desktop control for MCP-capable agents that works in the background.

interface.shortDescription: Background desktop control for MCP-capable agents
interface.longDescription: UltraTerm Computer Use lets an agent operate desktop apps through a local macOS app or native Linux and Windows runtimes while the person keeps using the computer. It does not take focus or move the real pointer unless that is switched on, refuses actions aimed at a stale screen, and keeps screenshots and accessibility data on the machine.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this app's current state without bringing it forward
Fill in this form in the background and pass state_id with every action
Find the Save button with a targeted query and press it
